annual.debt_basis: total tag (LongTermDebt, long-term incl. current maturities; no short-term borrowings filed)

ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2025 DPS 1.6 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.42, 2026-06-30: 0.42) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.38, 2025-06-30: 0.38) — mixed basis: the full-year total is a declared fact and the quarters are paid facts, so the year-over-year change in the paid quarterly rate is applied to the declared total (a payment declared in one quarter and paid in the next can shift by a quarter)
dividends.dps_basis_detail: paid facts for periods ending 2018-03-31..2026-06-30; declared facts for the periods the paid tag does not cover (2014-12-31..2017-12-31, 13 facts); declared FY facts for 8 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no paid FY fact and no four paid quarterly facts (2018-12-31, 2019-12-31, 2020-12-31, 2021-12-31, 2022-12-31, 2023-12-31, 2024-12-31, 2025-12-31); the paid tag files quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-06-30, the declared tag only full-year facts — the quarterly tag is primary (the declared tag's full-year facts fill only fiscal years the paid tag does not cover)
dividends.frequency_basis: spacing of the latest 4 positive quarterly DPS facts (2025-06-30, 2025-09-30, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30); the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

share_issuance.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

dividends.price_note: price: neither prices.json nor score.json carries a price — yields null
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

dps_basis: paid facts for periods ending 2018-03-31..2026-06-30; declared facts for the periods the paid tag does not cover (2014-12-31..2017-12-31, 13 facts); declared FY facts for 8 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no paid FY fact and no four paid quarterly facts (2018-12-31, 2019-12-31, 2020-12-31, 2021-12-31, 2022-12-31, 2023-12-31, 2024-12-31, 2025-12-31) — the series switches basis where one tag stops; the switch year can double-count or skip one payment (a dividend declared in one quarter and paid in the next)

buybacks: quarters left out (not a sign error) — quarter ended 2023-12-31: the year-to-date facts decrease (2023-01-01..2023-09-30 = 115,521,000 > 2023-01-01..2023-12-31 = 114,378,000) — no quarter can be derived from them (the quarterly row read -1.1M; typically a line tagged in one filing and not in the next); left out (a missing quarter)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 1.6 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.42, 2026-06-30: 0.42) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.38, 2025-06-30: 0.38) — mixed basis: the full-year total is a declared fact and the quarters are paid facts, so the year-over-year change in the paid quarterly rate is applied to the declared total (a payment declared in one quarter and paid in the next can shift by a quarter)

frequency: the FY2025 total is a declared fact and the quarterly facts inside that year are paid facts — the payment count needs both from one tag, so the cadence is read from the spacing of the quarterly facts
